title: Open-LLM Intake Orchestrator and Pinflow
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build an end-to-end orchestrator for ingesting community/open-source LLM weights, running deterministic conversion pipelines, performing staged validation (sanity, tokenization parity, micro-benchmarks, lightweight quality checks), and producing a canonical version pin + published performance profile in the model catalog. The orchestrator must produce auditable provenance metadata (source URL, commit/tag, checksums), support gated retries for conversion failures, and emit structured artifacts consumable by Console and the admission pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Automated intake job accepts a weights URL or registry reference, records source metadata (checksum, git ref, model card link)
Conversion runs in reproducible container images; outputs conform to runtime packaging spec and pass checksum verification
Validation stage includes tokenization parity test, latency/throughput microbenchmarks (p50/p95), and a lightweight quality eval on a small prompt set; results stored in profile JSON
Successful onboards create a pin in the model catalog with: semantic version, content-hash suffix, and compatibility tags (quantized/int8/fp16)
Failure modes produce actionable alerts with logs and automatic labelling (requires manual triage for unknown-layer formats)
Published performance profile is visible in Console runtime-1.20 catalog and linked to rollout policies

rollout_plan: Stage 0: Manual trigger from PRD for curated HF models (limited to core team)
Stage 1: Automated intake for HF/S3 with conversion in a gated conversion-farm (internal queue)
Stage 2: Canary publish in catalog with tag 'canary' and 1-week telemetry collection
Stage 3: Promote to pinned release (semanticX+hash) after quality metrics meet thresholds
Stage 4: Enable full public onboarding with rate limits and monitoring alerts
